node_catalog.DocumentationTopic: One canonical official documentation route; navigation existence is separate from semantic parsing.
node_catalog.APISymbol: Versioned export/function/class/property/method identity; JS and WAAPI symbols remain separate.
node_catalog.SourceFact: Bound statement from pinned official source/type/manifest; never runtime proof.
node_catalog.Example: Official example source, status source-observed-not-runtime-executed unless locally witnessed.
node_catalog.Recipe: Bounded task guidance with prerequisites, ordered sources, actions, validation requirement, unknowns and abstention.
node_catalog.Task: User or agent intent plus target, constraints and acceptance criterion.
node_catalog.WorkEpisode: Append-only bounded work envelope; not a Lesson.
node_catalog.Symptom: Observed statement, requiring a witness for observed status.
node_catalog.Fix: Proposed change; not validated by proposal.
node_catalog.Evidence: Typed source or witness with immutable identity, selector, digest and assertion scope.
node_catalog.Inference: Explicit reasoning over evidence; cannot masquerade as fact.
node_catalog.EvidenceGap: Named missing binding or witness with owner and closure condition.
node_catalog.NextQuestion: Missing element, target artifact, exact locator, reason and stop condition.

relation_rules: All relations are directed, closed-triple, evidence-referenced, owner-routed and carry cycle policy plus forbidden inference.
Read inverses are computed, never stored.
No relation creates authority, promotion, execution, understanding, correctness, performance, accessibility or production effects.
generalizesFrom requires a closed episode; a verified Lesson additionally requires succeeded Outcome and TestObserved or ExecutedWitness evidence.
Failed or inconclusive Outcomes cannot support a prescriptive verified Lesson.
Conflicting records remain present and force scoped abstention.
task_recipes: getting-started -> README usage -> pinned package exports
scope root/media/revert -> clean-inline-styles; framework result deferred
specific utility/easing descendant, never family-only citation
requirements -> when-to-use -> API differences -> chosen distinct symbol
execution order -> engine setting or adapter binding
target recipe -> version context -> symptom -> migration mapping if applicable
documented considerations only; project performance requires ExecutedWitness
Scope reduceMotion example is guidance only; conformance requires separate evidence
version gate -> exact wiki mapping -> local scan -> execution witness
query_policy: Unknown version yields navigation-only results. Missing, stale, conflicting, unverified-only, or behavior-without-witness support returns ABSTAIN_UNSUPPORTED plus a typed EvidenceGap and NextQuestion; suggestions never execute work.

distinct exports and JS/WAAPI symbols with pinned source/type/test/example bindings

copyright_rules: Store titles, identifiers, signatures, short field names, URLs, selectors and hashes as necessary factual metadata.
Write original concise paraphrases; do not mirror page prose, examples, screenshots or whole code samples.
Example records describe purpose and point to immutable official bytes; they do not embed the example wholesale.
Any unavoidable quotation must be minimal, attributed and separately marked quoted_excerpt.
A deterministic similarity/length policy rejects multi-paragraph or page-substantial copied prose.
Preserve upstream license identity and never imply the private vault republishes official documentation.
update_protocol: Capture a new live documentation crawl with timestamp, canonical routes, selectors and content digests.
Diff routes, redirects, headings and digests against the prior snapshot; never overwrite prior SourceRecords.
Resolve the relevant release/tag to immutable commit and capture package export, source/type/test/example digests.

Mark dependent facts, recipes and lessons stale-pending-review on route removal, selector loss, digest change, export change, package major/minor mismatch, lock mismatch or environmental-precondition change.
Preserve conflicts and invalidations as new records.
Regenerate views deterministically and validate their source digest map.
Write the terminal validation receipt only after every artifact validates.
Promotion, publication, release, runtime integration and authority changes remain separate owner gates.
